Full skill text at 5★
Each time the owner gains an attribute buff, restores self HP by 20% of Max HP. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times during each of the owner's turns. When the owner takes Direct DMG, grants self [DEF Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns, CD: 1 turn. When the owner takes DoT, grants self [Mastery RES Up II] for 2 turns, CD: 1 turn.
Full skill text at 7★
Each time the owner gains an attribute buff, restores self HP by 20% of Max HP. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times during each of the owner's turns. When the owner takes Direct DMG, grants self [DEF Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns, CD: 1 turn. When the owner takes DoT, grants self [Mastery RES Up II] for 2 turns, CD: 1 turn. Each time the effect is triggered, also increases the owner's Turn Meter by 6%. If the owner is of the Defense Class, grants all allies 1 layer of [Sacred Protection] at the beginning of each wave: When taking Fatal DMG, the owner consumes 1 layer of [Sacred Protection] and is immune to this death; meanwhile, gains [Immortal] and the owner's Turn Meter cannot be reduced, lasting for 1 turn, up to 1 layer.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [DEF Up Ⅱ] — Increases DEF by 60%.
  • [Mastery RES Up II] — Increases Mastery RES by 50%.
  • [Sacred Protection] — When taking Fatal DMG, the owner consumes 1 layer of [Sacred Protection] and is immune to this death. Meanwhile, gains [Immortal] and the owner's Turn Meter cannot be reduced, lasting for 1 turn.
  • [Immortal] — Will not die from DMG and will remain 1 HP at least.
